narrative.overview: ForumScope translates the botanical folio into a calm, repeatable way to compare public discussion: each answer is registered against the same visible scale while the content remains a working forum-analysis tool. Deep leaf green anchors the shell; warm ground, restrained serif titles, measured density, and one evidence ruler carry the chosen world without changing familiar web navigation or controls.
keyCharacteristics: Warm field ground and deep green navigation anchor.
Georgia display titles paired with readable system UI sans.
Flat surfaces, tonal layers, and fine sepia rules.
One fixed 0–100 evidence ruler repeated for every answer.
Scarlet marks selection/focus precisely; state labels remain textual.

rules.name: The Registered Evidence Rule
rules.body: Scarlet marks a specific selected or measured point; it never floods a whole panel.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for titles; operational copy, controls, evidence, and navigation stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Ranked answers always use one fixed 0–100 ruler with the same tick positions.

rules.name: The Flat Folio Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and hairline rules first; reserve elevation for transient feedback.

dos: Do keep navigation and primary actions anchored by leaf green.
Do compare answers on a common fixed-scale evidence ruler.
Do pair relevance color with a written label and numeric score.
Do keep demo content visibly marked synthetic and LLM use opt-in.
donts: Don't use botanical drawings or textures as decoration.
Don't use scarlet as a second primary-action color.
Don't use decorative gradients, glass, or floating-card grids.
Don't present heuristic ranking as a moderation verdict.
